instruction: Candid outdoor full shot from a high angle of a couple walking down a rocky path next to a marble wall. The woman in the white sweater and beige hat (R1) is on the left, looking towards her partner while touching the stone wall with her right hand. The man in the brown sweater and dark hat (R2) walks on the right, holding her hand and looking down. Soft natural daylight casts gentle shadows, emphasizing the cool blue-gray marble background and their warm-toned autumn attire.
